summary: Exited at +31.25pts after the position ran to a peak of +108.25 and then gave back 61% of the trailing 112pt leg in a single bar. The trigger was a rare triple confluence of against-trend fires (CLIMAX, HA, and PROPP all firing against simultaneously) plus extreme z-scores on the 5m/15m (z_close_vs_high -5.0/-2.98) -- the first time all three signals agreed against the position. Next time I'd watch for this same triple-confluence-against pattern as the primary exit trigger, and treat single isolated against-fires (like the lone PROPP-against at t=7m that didn't pan out into a real reversal) as noise rather than pre-empting on those alone.
